register.formality: "Sie" (formal), as the Jira and Azure DevOps German UIs address the reader. Buttons are infinitives (Speichern, Löschen).
register.note: Nouns capitalised; compound nouns closed up (Arbeitselement, Designergebnis). A sentence-final ellipsis is "…" with no space before it. Long compounds may need a soft hyphen (­ is not available in messages — prefer a shorter synonym on tight controls).
